analogy.rationale: Acetylcholinesterase inhibitors act by raising acetylcholine at cholinergic synapses, so the closest transcriptional match is another cholinesterase inhibitor; cholinergic receptor agonists/antagonists share the same pathway but the nine cell lines are non-neuronal and express little cholinergic machinery, so overall responses should be weak.
